CatalogSearch.intro: Find the Part in the catalog, then give your price for it.

CatalogSearch.nothingFoundInTheCategory: No Part in <category/> holds every word of “<words/>” in its name, its manufacturer or a part number. Check the spelling, or search every Category.

CatalogSearch.pastTheLast: This page is past the last one.

CatalogSearch.askIntroEveryCategory: If the catalog lacks it, the Admin can add it: the form starts with your words.

NewOffer.title: Add an Offer
NewOffer.intro: Adding it confirms it, as of today.
NewOffer.notRead: The Part could not be read.

OfferForm.pricesDescription: Give it in dollars, in dinars or in both.
OfferForm.usdPriceDescription: With cents if you use them, such as <example/>.
OfferForm.inStockDescription: Turn it off when you have none now.
OfferForm.taken: You already have an Offer for this Part. Go back to the search, where it is marked.

usdPrice.missing: Give a price in dollars, in dinars or in both.
usdPrice.notANumber: Write the price in digits only.
usdPrice.notPositive: The price has to be more than zero.
usdPrice.tooManyDecimals: Dollars take at most two digits after the point.
usdPrice.tooLarge: The price is over the limit.

iqdPrice.notANumber: Write the price in digits only.
iqdPrice.notPositive: The price has to be more than zero.
iqdPrice.tooManyDecimals: Dinars are whole: leave out the point and what follows it.
iqdPrice.tooLarge: The price is over the limit.

inStock.missing: Say whether you have it in stock.

warrantyMonths.notANumber: Write the months in digits only.
warrantyMonths.notPositive: The warranty is at least one month. Leave it empty if you give none.
warrantyMonths.tooLarge: The warranty is over the limit.
warrantyMonths.notWholeMonths: The warranty is in whole months.

refused.other: The platform did not accept this.

OfferScreen.title: Your Offer
OfferScreen.notRead: Your Offer could not be read.
OfferScreen.intro: Saving it confirms it, as of today, even when nothing changed.
OfferScreen.goneDescription: It was removed. Your other Offers are on your list.

RemoveOffer.title: Remove this Offer?
RemoveOffer.description: Shoppers no longer see your Offer for this Part. You can add it again later from the catalog search.

PartRequestsScreen.notListed: Your Part Requests could not be listed.
PartRequestsScreen.offerRemoved: You have since removed its Offer.
PartRequestsScreen.noneDescription: When a Part you sell is not in the catalog, ask the Admin to add it. Shoppers see your Offer once it is added.

PartRequestsScreen.pastTheLast: This page is past the last one.

ContactDetailsForm.title: Your contact details
ContactDetailsForm.intro: You change these yourself, and they are saved at once.

mapLocation.outsideIraq: This place is outside Iraq. Check that the latitude comes first, before the longitude.

instagramName.notAnInstagramName: An Instagram name holds only the letters a to z, digits, dots and underscores.

MapLocationField.notAllowed: This browser was not allowed to give its position. Type the coordinates instead.

OfferSheetScreen.title: Your Offer sheet
OfferSheetScreen.intro: Change many Offers at once: download them as one file, change it, and upload it here.
OfferSheetScreen.inTheFile_one: The file holds a row for your <count/> Offer, with English headings.
OfferSheetScreen.inTheFile_other: The file holds a row for each of your <count/> Offers, expired ones too, with English headings.
OfferSheetScreen.inTheFileNone: You have no Offer yet, so the file holds its English headings alone, ready to fill.
OfferSheetScreen.notDownloaded: Your Offer sheet was not downloaded.
OfferSheetScreen.uploadIntro: A row you change changes its Offer, a row you add makes one, and an Offer whose row you delete is left as it is.
OfferSheetScreen.fileDescription: The <xlsx/> file you downloaded here and changed.
OfferSheetScreen.uploadingStatus: Applying the rows of <file/>. A file of thousands of rows takes a few seconds.
OfferSheetScreen.notUploaded: Your Offer sheet was not uploaded.

refused.tooLarge: The file is too large. Split its rows into two files and upload each.
refused.notReadable: This file cannot be read. Save it again as an <xlsx/> file and upload it.
refused.notTheLayout: This is not an Offer sheet. Only a file downloaded from this screen is taken, with its six headings in the first row.
refused.tooManyRows: The file has too many rows. Split them into two files and upload each: rows a file leaves out are left as they are.

OfferSheetScreen.holdsColumns: Six columns, in this order: the part number, the Part’s name, the price in dollars and in dinars, whether it is in stock, and the warranty in months.
OfferSheetScreen.holdsMatch: A row finds its Part by its part number alone. The name is there for you to read.
OfferSheetScreen.holdsEmpty: An empty price is one you do not quote, and an empty warranty is none.
OfferSheetScreen.holdsConfirms: Uploading confirms every Offer a row applies to, even one you did not change.
OfferSheetScreen.read_one: <count/> row read: <applied/> applied and <skipped/> skipped. Your Offers already show the change.
OfferSheetScreen.read_other: <count/> rows read: <applied/> applied and <skipped/> skipped. Your Offers already show the change.
OfferSheetScreen.readAllApplied_one: <count/> row read and applied. Your Offers already show the change.
OfferSheetScreen.readAllApplied_other: <count/> rows read, all applied. Your Offers already show the change.
OfferSheetScreen.readNone: The file holds no row below its headings, so nothing was changed.
OfferSheetScreen.skippedIntro: These rows changed nothing. Correct them in the file and upload it again: rows already applied are only confirmed again.

noPart.title: No Part has the part number
noPart.intro: If the catalog lacks the Part, ask for it to be added: the form starts with the row.

severalParts.title: Several Parts have the part number
severalParts.intro: Add the Offer for the Part you mean from the catalog search, then delete the row.

samePart.title: Another row names the same Part
samePart.intro: Neither row was applied, so that neither price wins. Keep one row for the Part.

notValid.title: A cell does not fit
notValid.intro: Each row says its first cell that does not fit, by the file’s heading.

OfferSheetScreen.addedIntro: Each new row found its Part. Shoppers see these Offers now.
OfferSheetScreen.matchedTitle: Applied to the Offer you have
OfferSheetScreen.matchedIntro: Several Parts share these rows’ part numbers. Each row was applied to the one you offer.
OfferSheetScreen.ask: Ask for it to be added
OfferSheetScreen.alreadyAsked: You have already asked for it.
OfferSheetScreen.moreInTheSearch_one: And <count/> more, which the catalog search shows.
OfferSheetScreen.moreInTheSearch_other: And <count/> more, which the catalog search shows.

cell.partNumberMissing: A row needs a part number. An Offer whose Part has none is changed on your Offers screen.
cell.partNumberTooLong: The part number is over the limit.
cell.notReadable: This cell cannot be read. Write a value in it, not a formula that gives none.
